en-US.description: Upload original model images and a target face image to replace the model's facial features with one click. To also replace skin tone and hairstyle, use AI Model Swap instead.
en-US.empty.baseModelImages: Upload at least 1 original model image first
en-US.empty.targetFaceImage: Upload a target face image first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.label: AI Face Swap
en-US.toast.success: AI face swap image generated successfully!
en-US.upload.baseModelImages.help: Upload up to 10 original model images. Only facial features will be replaced — skin tone, hairstyle, outfit, and scene are preserved.
en-US.upload.targetFaceImage.help: Use a clear frontal or three-quarter face photo. Only facial features will be extracted. Skin tone, hairstyle, clothing, and background will not be copied.

zh-CN.description: 上传模特图和目标人脸图，一键 AI 换脸，替换模特面部特征。如需替换肤色和发型，请使用 AI 换模特。
zh-CN.empty.baseModelImages: 请先上传至少 1 张原模特图
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置

zh-CN.upload.baseModelImages.help: 支持上传多张原模特图（最多 10 张），仅替换面部特征，保留肤色、发型、服饰与场景。
